competitors.name: LendingClub (XBRL entity name Happen, Inc.)
competitors.why: Direct digital personal-loan lender to prime consumers; also a bank (deposits fund loans) and sells loans to investors, the same model as SoFi's Lending segment. Competes for the same borrowers and for the same whole-loan buyers.

metrics.note: gross interest income and noninterest income as reported in XBRL (not net revenue); SoFi Lending Q3 2026 net revenue 821.3M +66% yoy is a different, net basis

competitors.name: Upstart Holdings
competitors.why: AI-underwriting personal-loan marketplace; sells the same prime and near-prime borrowers and bank/credit-union partners that SoFi's Loan Platform Business also serves.

competitors.name: Robinhood Markets
competitors.why: Competes with SoFi Invest and SoFi Crypto for the same young investors, and is moving into banking, cards and cash management (Gold card, sweep deposits) where SoFi Money competes.

competitors.name: Ally Financial
competitors.why: Largest US digital-only deposit bank (savings, checking, CDs) and consumer lender; competes with SoFi Checking and Savings for deposits on APY and with SoFi Invest.

metrics.note: XBRL 'revenue' and 'operating income' for a bank are not comparable to SoFi's net revenue; growth sign is the usable reading

competitors.name: Capital One Financial
competitors.why: Names itself in rewards credit cards (SoFi Credit Card competes), personal loans and online savings (360 Savings); a large bank in personal loans and deposits.

metrics.note: revenue growth 2025 likely includes the effect of the Discover acquisition (hypothesis, not verified from the files); XBRL operating income not comparable

competitors.name: Nu Holdings
competitors.why: Closest digital-bank growth analogue (members, products per member, deposits funding lending) but operates in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia, so it is a comparison of model and growth, not a competitor for SoFi's US customers.

metrics.note: latest year in the prefetch is FY2024; no US overlap

bottlenecks.reading: Scarce input: low-cost funding. SoFi's deposits grew $5.8B in Q3 2026 to $51.3B and made up 90% of average liabilities; the average deposit rate was 145 bp below warehouse facilities, about $745M of annualised interest-expense savings. A bank charter lets SoFi fund personal loans (originations $12.6B, +69% yoy) on its own balance sheet, which non-bank lenders without a charter (Upstart as a marketplace) cannot; LendingClub has a charter too. The advantage lasts as long as deposit growth keeps pricing below market funding and SoFi pays a competitive APY (10-K risk factor).

Demand side: US unsecured personal-loan balances reached a record $281B, +9.6% yoy, with originations +19.5% yoy (TransUnion Q2 2026). SoFi's personal-loan originations grew +69% yoy in Q3 2026, far faster than the market, which is share gain on the originations measure (balance-sheet vs platform split: $9.0B own balance sheet, $3.6B Loan Platform Business).

Constraint on growth: capital and credit. Faster balance-sheet lending uses capital and rests on credit quality; TransUnion shows the share of personal-loan borrowers 60+ days past due rising (3.81% vs 3.37% a year earlier per a secondary summary of the report), and the 10-K names concentration in a small number of whole-loan and Loan Platform Business purchasers whose demand can fluctuate. SoFi's personal loan charge-off rate in Q3 2026 was 2.26% as reported in the release summary (includes asset-sale effects).

Technology Platform is shrinking, not a bottleneck owner: segment net revenue fell 24% yoy to $87.4M in Q3 2026 and accounts fell 11% to 140M because a large client fully transitioned off the platform before 2025-12-31. Competitors in platform-as-a-service are only described generically in the 10-K (other technology platforms), no names, so the share reading is a gap.

Hypothesis: the limiting input for the Financial Services growth is cheap member acquisition and primary-account status (direct deposit) against Ally, Capital One, Chime, Robinhood and large banks. No attributed, comparable figure was found for competitors' deposit share, so this stays a hypothesis.

notes: fd NAMED COMPETITORS (10-K Item 1A, risk factors, pf_10k_20260217): SoFi names no company by name; it names classes: other personal loan, student loan refinancing, in-school and home loan lenders including banks and credit card issuers; banks with checking and savings; rewards credit cards (SoFi Credit Card); other brokerage firms incl. online and mobile platforms (SoFi Invest); fintech mortgage lenders; social media and commerce platforms with peer-to-peer and in-app payments; digital asset and global remittance providers; other technology platforms for Galileo and Technisys; content providers (Lantern); firms for SoFi At Work. The company-level names in competitors[] (LC, UPST, HOOD, ALLY, COF, NU) come from the owner's list and the prefetch peers, with the reason in each entry; Chime and Marcus/Goldman are private or no longer filing a comparable standalone segment and have no SEC companyfacts in this run.

fd SHARE lending: SoFi Lending segment net revenue Q3 2026 821.3M, +66% yoy (pf_rel_20261027_1). LendingClub Q3 2026 interest income 278.3M, +15.1% yoy and noninterest income 80.1M, -25.7% yoy (fd_cf_LC); Upstart Q2 2026 revenue 364.7M, +41.8% yoy (fd_cf_UPST). SoFi is growing lending revenue faster than both on reported lines (bases differ: SoFi net of funding costs; LC and UPST gross/total as per XBRL); US personal-loan originations grew +19.5% yoy (fd_transunion_q2_2026) and SoFi's personal-loan originations +69% (pf_rel_20261027_1), so SoFi is taking share of originations on these numbers.

fd SHARE investing/banking: SoFi Financial Services net revenue Q3 2026 525.1M, +25% yoy, products 23.2M +44% (pf_rel_20261027_1). Robinhood total revenue Q3 2026 1,424M, +11.8% yoy and net income 468M versus 556M a year earlier (fd_cf_HOOD): Robinhood is far larger in revenue and profitable, SoFi's Financial Services segment is growing faster in percent but from a smaller base. Ally FY2025 revenue -3.3% (pf_peer_ALLY): the incumbent digital bank is not growing, consistent with SoFi gaining deposits (+$5.8B in the quarter).
fd SHARE platform: SoFi Technology Platform revenue Q3 2026 87.4M, -24% yoy (pf_rel_20261027_1); no named platform competitor numbers (gap).

fd MARKET direction: TransUnion Q2 2026, record 281B unsecured personal loan balances +9.6% yoy; 26.9M consumers hold personal loans (fd_transunion_q2_2026, published 2026-08-06). A secondary-site figure that fintechs made 45.0% of new personal loans in Q1 2026 (39.8% a year earlier) was NOT confirmed on the TransUnion page and is not used as evidence.

fd COMPARABILITY: competitor revenue lines are XBRL tags (gross interest income for LC, total revenue for UPST/HOOD, bank revenue for ALLY/COF/NU) and are not the same basis as SoFi segment net revenue; use growth direction only, not margin levels. COF 2025 growth is likely acquisition-inflated (hypothesis).
